settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Customize Cassini (background, theme, etc.).
settings.bgHint: Pick an image to use as the app background.
settings.overlayHint: Darkens the background image for better readability.
settings.accentHint: Main tint used on buttons and active navigation.
settings.sgdbHint: Fetches cover images for Epic, Battle.net & other games. Leave empty to use first-letter fallback.
settings.updateHint: Check if a new version of Cassini is available.
settings.clearAllHint: Deletes all local data: library, settings, cache. The app will restart.
settings.clearWebviewCacheHint: Clears the image and resource cache of the built-in browser (does not affect your web browser).
settings.clearAllConfirm: Are you sure? All local data will be permanently deleted.
settings.ambientHint: Plays a soft background music on loop throughout the app.
settings.musicParticlesHint: Show animated snow particles in the background of the music page.
settings.autostartHint: Automatically start Cassini when Windows boots.
settings.runInBgHint: When closing the window, Cassini keeps running in the system tray.
settings.patchNotesHint: View what's new and fixed in the latest update.

v2_1_0.new_0: [Solar system] Phase portals to jump between launchers without leaving the view
v2_1_0.new_1: [Solar system] Keyboard movement (WASD / ZQSD), remappable keys and adjustable sensitivity
v2_1_0.new_2: [Solar system] Game card next to its planet, collapsible game list, frame counter
v2_1_0.new_3: [Ambiance] Three tracks chained with a crossfade, one picked at random on startup
v2_1_0.fix_0: [Solar system] Rings are no longer reserved for the largest planets
v2_1_0.fix_1: [Solar system] Guaranteed wide gap between the sun and the innermost orbit
v2_1_0.fix_2: [Library] Game count displayed three times over
v2_1_0.fix_3: [Library] Launchers absent from the PC are no longer offered in the filter
v2_1_0.fix_4: [Library] Game folder access restored for Steam games
v2_1_0.perf_0: [Startup] Opens straight onto the solar system, intro animation removed
v2_1_0.perf_1: [Startup] Settings loaded in a single call instead of a couple of dozen

v1_2_0.new_0: [Music] Metadata saved directly into audio files, no more network search on startup
v1_2_0.new_1: [Music] Change artwork via right-click, image embedded directly into the audio file
v1_2_0.new_2: [Music] MusicBrainz added as a 3rd artwork source, no API key required
v1_2_0.new_3: [Music] Animated snow particles in the background of the music page
v1_2_0.new_4: [Settings] Option to disable animated particles in the Ambiance section
v1_2_0.fix_0: [Music] Raised match threshold for fewer incorrect covers

v1_1_3.new_0: [Music] Last 10 played tracks section, persisted across sessions
v1_1_3.new_2: [Mini-player] Animated appearance and disappearance of the persistent bar
v1_1_3.new_3: [Music] Move a track to another folder via right-click
v1_1_3.fix_0: [Mini-player] Play/pause/prev/next buttons no longer shift based on track title length
v1_1_3.fix_1: [Settings] App now correctly stays in background when closing the window
v1_1_3.fix_2: [Mini-player] Clicking the track title now navigates to the correct folder
v1_1_3.change_0: [Global] Visual redesign of sidebar, typography, scrollbars and hover animations

v1_1_2.new_0: [Music] Automatic artwork search via iTunes for all tracks
v1_1_2.new_1: [Mini-player] Online artwork now displayed in the bottom bar
v1_1_2.new_3: [Music] Shuffle and repeat modes for track playback
v1_1_2.new_4: [Mini-player] Shuffle and repeat buttons, state saved between sessions
v1_1_2.new_5: [Mini-player] Draggable thumb on progress and volume bars
v1_1_2.new_6: [Music] Refresh button to rescan the folder without reselecting it
v1_1_2.fix_0: [Library] Steam game images stay visible even after uninstalling
v1_1_2.fix_1: [Music] Enrichment now processes all tracks from app startup
v1_1_2.fix_2: [Mini-player] No more audio glitch when dragging the progress bar
v1_1_2.fix_3: [Mini-player] Reliable play and pause after scrubbing the track
v1_1_2.perf_0: [Music] Stricter artwork matching to avoid incorrect results

v1_1_1.new_0: [Settings] Release notes displayed on every new version
v1_1_1.perf_0: [Music] Large music libraries load much faster
v1_1_1.perf_1: [Music] Album artwork loads progressively as you scroll
v1_1_1.perf_2: [Music] Progress bar while track metadata is loading

v1_1_0.new_0: [Music] Track title, artist, album and duration displayed automatically
v1_1_0.new_1: [Music] Full album artwork on track cards with duration overlay
v1_1_0.new_2: [Music] Text stays readable on light-coloured artwork

v1_0_51.new_0: [Global] Built-in dialogs, no more browser popups
v1_0_51.new_1: [Global] Visual notifications for confirmations and action feedback
v1_0_51.new_2: [Settings] Update available notification with download progress
v1_0_51.new_3: [Mini-player] Artwork, artist name and volume control in the persistent bar
v1_0_51.new_4: [Music] Customisable colour per folder via right-click
v1_0_51.new_5: [Music] Drag and drop tracks between folders
v1_0_51.change_0: [Music] Track durations stay visible when navigating between pages
v1_0_51.change_1: [Music] Sort tracks by name, duration or file type

v1_0_0.new_0: [Library] Game library with automatic detection of Steam, Epic Games and Battle.net
v1_0_0.new_1: [Music] Built-in music player with folder management
v1_0_0.new_3: [Settings] Customisable background image and accent colour
v1_0_0.new_4: [Settings] Automatic launch of ArcHive on Windows startup
v1_0_0.new_5: [Settings] Minimise to system tray when closing the window
